name: get_clash_results
author: hprebar
title: Get clash test results
description: Clash Detective tests — status, last run, result counts by status for every test (tests[]) — followed by up to maxResults results per test (results[]: test, name, status, distance and center in millimetres, the two clashing items). Optionally one test by name. Needs Navisworks Manage (hasClashModule). Read-only — run tests with create_and_run_clash_test.

testName.description: Only the test with this display name; empty = every test

maxResults.description: Results listed per test (counts are always complete)
